response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, long-tenured full-stack engineer with roughly 15 years of professional experience, strong open-source output, and evident community leadership through workshops and talks. However, the role is a director-level IC focused on AI strategy, cloud platform direction, and advising strategic customers, and the resume shows almost none of that profile: AI exposure is limited to recent MCP/agent tooling work, there is no demonstrated ML/AI product or platform ownership, minimal large-scale cloud architecture (only AWS CDK usage), and no evidence of executive-level influence, strategy setting, or customer/partner advisory work. Titles have remained Senior/Staff IC rather than Principal or Distinguished, which suggests a scope gap relative to expectations.
strengths: ~15 years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backends
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform with real users, showing entrepreneurial initiative
Strong knowledge-sharing track record: conference talks, workshops, and multi-module courses
concerns: Little demonstrated AI/ML expertise or shipped AI products beyond recent agent tooling
No director-level scope: no strategy ownership, org influence, or customer/partner advisory experience
Limited cloud-platform depth; no advanced degree in an AI-related field

key_factors.factor: AI expertise and shipped AI products
Breadth and longevity of engineering experience
